items.name: locale
items.title: locale
items.description: The Locale type ("zh-CN" | "en-US"), LOCALES, DEFAULT_LOCALE (zh-CN) and isLocale() for validating a stored choice. Shared by LocaleProvider and the formatting functions.

items.name: format-time
items.title: format-time
items.description: Time formatting for the browser's time zone, in Chinese by default or English: friendly() for the readable surface (刚刚, 12 分钟前, 今天 14:05, 9月21日 20:40; just now, 12 minutes ago, Today 14:05, Sep 21 20:40), exactTime() for local time to the millisecond with its UTC offset plus UTC and relative forms, and clock(), timestamp(), localDay(), relative(), utcOffset(). The readable forms take a locale argument. Accepts Date, ISO strings or epoch milliseconds.

items.name: clipboard
items.title: clipboard
items.description: copyText(text): copies with the async Clipboard API and falls back to execCommand on insecure (plain-http) pages; rejects when both fail.

items.name: time-range
items.title: time-range
items.description: Time ranges for filtering logs, runs and metrics: { last: "1h" } for a trailing range that moves with the clock, or { from, to } for whole local days (both included). formatTimeRange()/parseTimeRange() give the short text form for URLs ("1h", "2026-09-28..2026-10-01"), resolveTimeRange() the instants to query (from inclusive, to exclusive), describeTimeRange() the label in Chinese or English (最近 1 小时, Last 1 hour), and TIME_RANGE_PRESETS the usual choices.
